inputs.style:
Thrash Metal, aggressive, distorted electric guitars, double bass drums, fast tempo, harsh male vocals, technical riffs
Short complete song, target duration 30 seconds. Start singing immediately; no long instrumental intro. Prioritize the verse and chorus.

Machines wake while the city sleeps

Dead men dancing in their heads
Master of the iron song
Where the rhythm and the blood belong
